title: Structural stabilities, robust half-metallicity, magnetic anisotropy, and thermoelectric performance of the pristine/Ir-doped Sr2CaOsO6: strain modulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17142-17152
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02453F, Paper
Open Access

Samia Shahzadi, Ihab Mohamed Moussa, Sohail Mumtaz, S. Nazir
This study explores various traits of the pristine (prs.)/Ir-doped (dop.) Sr2CaOsO6 structure using ab initio calculations, where Ir is doped at the Os-site.
